facts.value: Universal Music UK Sound Foundation Bursary

An independent music education charity established in 1997 to celebrate the centenary of EMI Records, now generously supported by Universal Music, aiming to improve access to music education in the UK and in Ireland.
Community Music, Irish Music Performance, Music Education
Nick Mason CBE, Sir Paul McCartney, Yoko Ono, Sir Simon Rattle, Sir Cliff Richard, Diana Ross, Tina Turner
